valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2028 (year to Mar 2028) adjusted EPS viewed at the Nov 2027 target date, USD per share of the US common listing (no ADR conversion). FY2027 guide $45.60-$46.40 (midpoint $46.00) grown at an assumed 13% for FY2028 (buybacks of ~$5B/yr shrink the 116.7M diluted shares ~4-5%, plus operating profit growth); EPS x multiple.

bear.driver: GLP-1 distribution margin compression, Med-Surg weakness, slower buybacks

base.driver: Guide delivered, 13% EPS growth on specialty/oncology and buybacks

bull.driver: Oncology and Rx tech outperform, Precision Medicine and Option Care accretion

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $52 the close of $1,102.81 implies 21.2x FY2028 (24.0x FY2027 midpoint); no analyst-weighted target was sourced, so the close implies about 22x on bull-leaning EPS of $50 or 20x on EPS $55
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $52 (4.7 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS vs the $45.60-$46.40 guide, with North American Pharmaceutical and Oncology operating profit growth
valuation.next_disclosure: Fiscal Q3 2027 results, expected early February 2027

analyst_notes: Dated, named analyst target and rating calls from the last 12 months could not be verified from accessible sources (MarketBeat blocked; secondary snippets lacked reliable dates), so no events are listed. Search snippets showed consensus targets around $1,040 (MarketBeat/Fox Business, 19-20 ratings) and a Barclays raise to $1,000 from $925 reported for Aug 2026, unverified here. The base case of $1,040 is in line with that consensus.
